title: Rickover and the Atomic Energy Commission

tellings.quote: Well, first of all, the Atomic Energy Commission wasn't under Department of Energy till 76

plain: John Herrington, a former US Secretary of Energy, spoke with a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about Admiral Hyman Rickover, the officer behind America's nuclear-powered navy, and the Atomic Energy Commission, the government body that oversaw nuclear energy and weapons from 1946. Citing a written account called Underway My Way, Herrington says the Commission did not come under the Department of Energy until 1976. The point matters because it shows where nuclear secrets, and possibly other secrets, were held during those decades.
